title: DP-GEN model deviation
text: Model deviation measures disagreement among an ensemble of Deep Potential models. A high max force deviation marks unreliable configurations that should be labeled or filtered.

title: DeepMD lcurve diagnosis
text: A flat validation loss with falling training loss can indicate overfitting, data leakage, poor validation coverage, or an imbalanced dataset. Compare learning curves before changing model size.

title: DP-GEN trust thresholds
text: Candidate structures are usually selected between low and high model deviation trust thresholds. Structures above the high threshold are treated as failed or unreliable exploration points.

title: Local-LLMOps trace schema
text: Local-LLMOps records prompt, response, latency, source ids, tool calls, status, provider, model, token counts, metadata, and errors in SQLite for later debugging.

title: Local-LLMOps metrics
text: The metrics endpoint exposes total requests, failed requests, success rate, average latency, and p95 latency in a Prometheus-style text format.

title: RAG evaluation metrics
text: Context precision checks whether retrieved chunks are useful. Context recall checks whether the expected evidence was retrieved. Faithfulness checks whether the answer is grounded in retrieved context.

title: Agent tool evaluation
text: Agent evaluation should track tool call success rate, tool latency, error rate, and whether tool outputs improve final answer correctness.

title: Ollama provider mode
text: Setting LLMOPS_PROVIDER to ollama routes Local-LLMOps chat requests to a local Ollama model while keeping the same request logging and metrics interface.
